visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person's hand holds three Cantonese sausages (lap cheong) over a yellow cutting board in a clean, bright kitchen studio. A knife is used to make shallow score marks on one of the sausages. (2) The scene cuts to a black pan on an induction cooktop. White rice is poured from a metal strainer into the pan. (3) Water is poured into the pan from a stainless steel cup. The three sausages are then placed on top of the rice. (4) A close-up shows a finger pressing the 'On' button on the stovetop control panel. The water in the pan begins to boil vigorously around the sausages. (5) A pink, heavy cast-iron lid is placed on the pan. (6) In a separate pink pot, a colorful soup with tomatoes and leafy greens is shown. Pink chopsticks add cubes of fried tofu into the pot. (7) Red-tipped tongs remove the cooked sausages from the now-fluffy white rice in the first pan. (8) A white rice paddle fluffs the rice, with visible steam rising from the hot grains. (9) A yellow towel is placed over the pot before the lid is replaced for insulation. (10) Diagonally sliced sausages are shown on a white plate. In a frying pan, oil is heated, and an egg is cracked into it. (11) A bunch of green leafy vegetables is added to the hot pan after the egg is removed. (12) The pan is covered with a glass lid, and the chef vigorously shakes the pan over the burner to toss the vegetables. (13) The lid is removed to show the steamed, bright green vegetables. (14) The final dish is assembled in a pink bowl with rice, sausage slices, the fried egg, and the greens. Sauce is drizzled over the egg yolk.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @RosalinaKitchen. [Subtitle]: 準備3~4條港式臘腸 先清洗乾淨... (2) [Subtitle]: 可以在臘腸上劃開幾刀 讓臘腸內的油脂 可以釋放出來... (3) [Subtitle]: 這樣飯會比較有味道 (4) [Subtitle]: 先把米浸泡30分鐘 瀝乾後，放入鍋子裡 (5) [Subtitle]: 加入1:1的水量 (可以略多10~15ml) (6) [Subtitle]: 放3~4條臘腸或肝腸 (7) [Subtitle]: 開中火加熱 (8) [Subtitle]: 煮到滾的狀態 (9) [Subtitle]: 轉小火，蓋上鍋蓋悶煮8分半 (10) [Subtitle]: 關火後，悶15分鐘 (11) [Subtitle]: 等待的時候來煮番茄蔬菜湯 用昆布柴魚高湯包 加上番茄、蒜苗 金針菇、蒟蒻等... (12) [Subtitle]: 滾了之後再放入油豆腐 轉小火慢慢的煮 (13) [Subtitle]: 好啦~ 這邊的臘腸飯已經煮好囉！ (14) [Subtitle]: 先把臘腸拿出來 稍涼再切片 (15) [Subtitle]: 接著鬆一下飯 嗯~香噴噴的 ❤️ (16) [Subtitle]: 先蓋起來，保溫一下 (17) [Subtitle]: 臘腸切片好了！ (18) [Subtitle]: 鍋裡倒入油，開中火加熱 (19) [Subtitle]: 等油熱了，鍋子傾斜一邊， 把蛋到進來 (20) [Subtitle]: 像這樣靠一邊煎， 可以煎出美美的微笑蛋 ❤️ (21) [Subtitle]: 好囉， 現在蛋已經煎出脆皮 可以取出來了 ❤️ (22) [Subtitle]: 原來鍋子剩下的油 放入有機的塔菇菜 (23) [Subtitle]: 撒一點鹽調味 (24) [Subtitle]: 蓋上鍋蓋， 繼續中火慢慢的加熱 (25) [Subtitle]: 等看到蒸氣 鍋子搖晃一下 (26) [Subtitle]: 蓋著蓋子翻炒， 這樣就不會噴的到處都是啦~ (27) [Subtitle]: 超簡單的炒青菜 就完成啦~ (28) [Subtitle]: 原汁原味！ (29) [Subtitle]: 把飯放到碗裡 擺上臘腸片... (30) [Subtitle]: 微笑蛋放上來 青菜放上來... (31) [Subtitle]: 像這樣超簡單又家常的 『臘腸銷魂飯』 就完成啦~ ❤️ (32) [Subtitle]: 臘腸飯搭配『番茄蔬菜湯』 簡單又滿的一餐~ ❤️ (33) [Subtitle]: 半熟蛋沾一點醬油 ❤️ (34) [Slogan]: 更多美味料理 請追蹤我 IG 臉書：羅潔塔的廚房 YouTube:@RosalinaKitchen

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat acoustic guitar music with a steady rhythm begins, setting a cheerful and bright mood. No spoken words are present. (2) Sharp percussive sounds of a knife hitting a cutting board are heard, synchronized with the visual chopping of the sausage. (3) Soft rustling sounds of rice grains and the splash of water follow as ingredients are added to the pot. (4) A metallic clink and thud indicate the lid being placed on the pan, accompanied by the low hum of the induction burner. (5) Bubbling liquid sounds emerge, representing the boiling water inside the pot. (6) High-frequency sizzling noises start as oil is heated and an egg begins to fry in a pan. (7) Intense broadband sizzling sounds occur as a large amount of green vegetables is added to the hot oil. (8) Rhythmic metallic scraping and thudding sounds of the pan being shaken against the stove create a percussive effect that blends with the background music. (9) Soft clinking sounds of utensils against a bowl are heard during the final assembly of the dish. (10) The music swells slightly and maintains its bright, major-mode character until the very end.
